authorizationGate.requiredBeforeRun: An independent reviewer must verify the exact R2 JSON digest, R2 source-identity manifest, matrix-balance self-check, and source-policy check, then explicitly approve this exact protocol with START_POSITION_AUDIT_APPROVED=approved-by-parent.

purpose: Premeasurement diagnostic of generated start resources, lawful initial access, and frozen-state transit chokepoints. This protocol does not estimate a causal tribe effect and does not presuppose or authorize a buff, nerf, star change, AI change, rule change, or map-generation change.

supersedesWithoutAmendment.reasonForNewVersion: R2 replaces—not amends—R1 before measurement to enlarge independent-world coverage and freeze the missing analysis, failure, fingerprint, source-identity, and bootstrap rules.

sourceIdentityAtFreeze.executionPolicy: Before any output directory is created, reject every dirty or untracked path outside approvedDirtyPathAllowlist. Hash every outcomeRelevantSourcePath, record Node executable/version/platform/architecture and package-lock identity, and refuse a source HEAD other than requiredBaselineCommit. A changed digest or source identity requires a new protocol/review; it cannot be appended to this sample.

sampling.independentWorldDefinition: One unique {worldSeed,preset} generated 13x13 map. Exactly four cyclic roster-seat rotations are repeated outcomes inside that world cluster; they are not four independent maps.

seedSelectionCommitment.candidateTransform: Interpret the first four SHA-256 digest bytes as an unsigned big-endian integer, then candidate = (integer mod 2147483646) + 1.
seedSelectionCommitment.counterRule: For each preset independently, inspect counters from 0 upward; accept the first 64 candidates that are globally unique and outside every listed exclusion. No generated board, map fingerprint, initial metric, or match result is consulted by selection or acceptance.

sampling.rosterAssignmentRule: Within each preset stratum, the published SHA-counter world sequence assigns mixed-01, mixed-02, mixed-03, mixed-04 in that repeating order. This gives exactly 16 worlds per roster per preset and 32 worlds per roster overall; assignment is fixed before any game/map construction.
sampling.randomness: For each match randomSeed equals worldSeed. The runner resets its scoped AI RNG before each newGame and records the engine's realized opening order; it does not infer opening order from nominal seat.

expectedCounts.terrainFingerprints: Observed nonempty count only; neither roster rotations nor fingerprints increase the independent-world denominator.

recordSeparateVariables: actual opening-turn position: index of nominal seat in realized turnOrder
tribe definition identity and roster family
preset, world seed, terrain fingerprint, and full map-layout fingerprint
initial stars, initial technology signature, tribe passive, and shipped harvest cost
attemptStage and explicit unavailable/null fields for any failed-before-setup attempt
physicalGeneratedMapMetrics: owned fruit, animal, mineral, total owned resources
owned terrain counts and capital-adjacent terrain counts
first-turn shipped-reachable tile, neutral-expansion-tile, neutral-village, and terrain counts

per target class: target count, accessible target count, inaccessible target count, nearest geometric Manhattan comparator when a candidate exists, nearest lawful full-turn hops when any candidate is reachable, and chokepoint union count

stateDependentCapabilityMetrics.interpretation: This is an initial action-affordability/capability metric, not a pure generated-resource or map-placement metric. Shipped canHarvest jointly requires owned resource, relevant technology, current stars, and the tribe-specific harvest cost; initial stars can embody nominal-seat and realized-opening-order policy.
stateDependentCapabilityMetrics.controlledCapabilityEstimand: Descriptive standardized nominal-seat and opening-position capability contrasts conditional on initialStars, initialTechSignature, passive/harvestCost, preset, and roster. Tribe-definition indicators are intentionally not also included in this model because they deterministically encode the initial technology/passive bundle; this is not a tribe-effect model.
stateDependentCapabilityMetrics.standardizationTarget: For each finite capability metric, the empirical distribution of all finite R2 measurement rows for that metric. Predictions replace only the focal nominal-seat or opening-position value and preserve every row's observed capability covariates.

observations.lawfulAccessDefinition: First-turn movement is the union of shipped reachableTiles for actual initial units. The multi-turn diagnostic graph places each real initial unit at a candidate location, refreshes only that unit action flags, and recomputes outgoing edges only through shipped reachableTiles while retaining initial terrain, technology, passive, unit type, blockers, ports, and storm state.
targetClasses: unoccupied legal approach tile Chebyshev-adjacent to an opponent capital
observations.chokepointMetric: For each target class, a transit tile is a non-origin, non-target graph node whose removal makes a previously reachable target inaccessible. Record the union count, target-specific mandatory-transit tiles, target count, inaccessible count, and minimum lawful hop distance. This directed, single-unit, frozen-initial-state graph is a diagnostic, not a multiplayer, AI-policy, or causal-path claim.
observations.nullSemantics: Do not impute null legal distance or use Manhattan distance as a legal-path substitute. nearestTargetManhattan is null only when a target class has no candidates; nearestLegalFullTurnHops is null when candidates exist but none is lawfully reachable. Report their metric-specific null denominators separately.

outcomes.primary: 30-turn all-AI win indicator by nominal seat, with nominal seat and actual opening-turn position always recorded and analyzed separately.
secondary: all prespecified physical-map, capability, access, and chokepoint metrics
outcomes.eligibleForPrimaryOutcome: Only rows with attemptStage complete, gameover outcome, no callback/deadline/queue/exception/invariant/save-fixture failure, and complete state-derived outcome fields. Incomplete and failed rows remain raw evidence, never become losses, and are summarized by preset, roster, nominal seat, opening position, and world; unavailable state dimensions remain explicit null rather than stale data.

analysisPlan.estimand: Adjusted nominal-seat win-probability contrasts and separately adjusted opening-position win-probability contrasts over the R2 ordinary-map design. Initial-metric contrasts are descriptive diagnostics. None is a causal tribe, order, map, or rule-effect estimand.
analysisPlan.primaryOutcomeModel: Linear-probability regression on eligible tribe-match rows with intercept, nominal-seat indicators, actual-opening-position indicators, preset, roster family, and tribe-definition indicators. Standardize each focal nominal seat and separately each opening position over all eligible rows; report both prediction sets and all pairwise contrasts.
analysisPlan.physicalMetricModel: For each named physical generated-map/access/chokepoint metric with finite values, fit the same descriptive linear model as the primary outcome except the metric is the response. Standardize nominal-seat and opening-position predictions over that metric's finite rows. Report raw-row pointer, metric-specific finite/null denominators, cluster means, overall mean, predictions, and all pairwise contrasts.
analysisPlan.capabilityMetricModel: For immediatelyHarvestableOwnedResources, fit a separate descriptive linear model with intercept, nominal-seat indicators, actual-opening-position indicators, preset, roster family, initialStars, initial technology-signature indicators, passive/harvest-cost indicators, but no tribe-definition indicators. Standardize over the finite capability rows as stated above and label every output capability/affordability, not pure resource quality.
analysisPlan.clusterMeans: For every named initial metric, compute an unweighted mean of finite tribe-placement measurements within each {worldSeed,preset} cluster. Preserve finite-row and null-row denominators per cluster; target totals/inaccessible totals are separately aggregated from their raw targets. No null legal distance is numerically imputed.

bootstrap.worldClusterUnit: Resample the 128 independent {worldSeed,preset} clusters with all roster rotations and tribe-placement rows from a selected cluster together; never resample individual rotations or tribe rows independently.
bootstrap.completeReplicateRule: Every one of the requested 10,000 resamples must have an identified fit for a reported CI. If a point fit is singular or any bootstrap replicate is singular, retain the exact invalid-replicate count, set that analysis CI outputs to null, label the analysis inconclusive, and prohibit a triage signal. Never silently drop singular fits.

analysisPlan.failureSummaries: Produce machine-readable strata by preset, roster, nominal seat, opening position, and world. If all-AI setup never initialized, retain the planned preset/roster/world but set state-derived nominal-seat/opening-position/tribe fields null and count it as an unavailable-state failure stratum.
analysisPlan.fingerprints: Separately report attempted worlds, worlds with all-AI initialization, worlds with complete initial measurement, fully verified world clusters, nonempty unique terrain fingerprints, and nonempty unique full-layout fingerprints. Empty/null fingerprints are never counted as fingerprints. Full-layout duplicate groups are computed across distinct world clusters only.

decisionRuleBeforeMeasurement.signalThreshold: A nominal-seat primary-outcome contrast is a triage signal only when its absolute adjusted estimate is at least 10 percentage points and its 95% complete-cluster-bootstrap CI excludes the practical-equivalence band from -5 to +5 percentage points in the observed direction.

coverageAndIntegrityThresholds.bootstrapRequirement: 10000 identified resamples for every primary contrast

machineReadableDisposition.INCONCLUSIVE: Use when a coverage/integrity/bootstrap threshold fails, no contrast meets the signal threshold, an access/capability diagnostic is unavailable, or any result is otherwise insufficient. It cannot support a balance or causal conclusion.
machineReadableDisposition.TRIAGE_SIGNAL_REQUIRES_SEPARATE_DIAGNOSI: Use only when every threshold passes and at least one primary nominal-seat contrast meets the signal threshold. It only authorizes separate diagnosis/review of placement, opening order, resources, lawful access, and chokepoints; it does not authorize gameplay changes or causal claims.

decisionRuleBeforeMeasurement.evenWithSignal: Adjusted attenuation or persistence after any physical-map/capability/access adjustment is descriptive only. It must not be described as mediation, explanation, or causal evidence and cannot authorize a buff, nerf, star change, AI change, rule change, map-generation change, online change, or naval change.

retain: frozen R2 scenario matrix before first match
one raw row per attempted match including failures and attemptStage
raw JSON, CSV, and append-only NDJSON
source manifest with policy result, runtime identity, lockfile identity, and every required digest
metric analyses, failure strata, coverage/fingerprint accounting, machine-readable final disposition, and Markdown report
per-world nonempty fingerprints and duplicate-group accounting
evidenceRetention.saveSeparation: The regular initial save uses humanTribe:0 and must pass loadOnlineSnapshot. The all-AI observed setup uses humanTribe:-1 and is retained separately as evidence only; it is not represented as user-loadable.
evidenceRetention.noReplacement: No seed, roster assignment, rotation, failed row, incomplete row, or world may be replaced, selectively rerun, or appended. A later sample requires another new protocol identifier, digest, output directory, and review.

sanityOnlyExclusions.permitted: The R2 premeasurement verifier may validate protocol digest, SHA-counter schedule, matrix balance, and synthetic analysis edge cases without constructing a game or executing a frozen scenario. Generated-state harness tests may use only seeds outside R1 and R2 frozen blocks and must remain excluded from R2 rows.
sanityOnlyExclusions.forbidden: Do not execute any R2 frozen seed/preset scenario, construct an R2 game, or create R2 observed output before independent parent review.

limitations: All-AI, normal-difficulty, four-tribe, 13x13, legacy-generation evidence does not establish player-facing, human-strategy, online, or other-board-size fairness.
Deterministic per-scenario AI streams make runs reproducible but do not independently estimate AI random-stream variability.
Frozen-initial-state single-unit access and chokepoints exclude discovery, later technology, captures, movement/cooperation, combat, policy, visibility, and future game state.
Fingerprints can detect duplicate layouts but cannot turn roster rotations into independent maps.
Every adjusted outcome or metric association remains descriptive and noncausal.
